Harbor ferry returns

The harbor ferry resumed service on Wednesday after engineers completed repairs to its landing stage. Commuters gathered before sunrise, and the first boat carried residents, bicycles and supplies across the bay. The restored route cuts a long road journey to a short crossing.

Inspectors checked the repaired platform before passengers boarded. The harbor authority said the timetable would remain limited during the first week, while crews monitored the new equipment and recorded passenger numbers. A permanent schedule will follow the public consultation.

The crossing connects our school and market, said a resident who uses the ferry each morning.

Readers can consult the published timetable before travelling. Local businesses plan to compare customer visits during the trial with the figures collected before the repairs began.
